photo-pose.install_method: Custom-built in-session. pip install mediapipe (+ deps) into the target profile's bundled Python, then copy the photo_pose/ package into that profile's portable/scripts/addons/.
photo-pose.notes: Detects a body pose from a single reference photo (MediaPipe Pose Landmarker, local/offline) and applies it to a Rigify FK rig: spine (single bend), head, upper/lower arms, upper/lower legs. v0.2.0 adds basic ground-snap: after posing the limbs, shifts the whole body (via the 'torso' bone) so the lower foot rests at its original ground height instead of floating -- fixes kneel/crouch poses, still no horizontal (X/Y) weight-shift correction. Requires the generated Rigify rig object, not the metarig. Bakes in a fix for standard Rigify limb rigs: forces IK_FK=1.0 on limb parent bones before posing (the IK constraint's driver-controlled influence otherwise silently overrides FK edits), and translates 'torso' rather than 'root' for grounding since 'root' is an unrelated disconnected bone in this rig and torso's own parent has a switch-parent constraint that would override a direct edit. MediaPipe + deps installed straight into the photo-pose profile's own bundled Python (fully isolated). Validated against both a standing (yoga) and a kneeling reference photo. v0.4.0 adds sync_ik (on by default): after posing, snaps every limb's IK end controls and pole targets to match the FK result, so a limb's IK_FK can be flipped to 0 afterward for manual IK dragging with no visual jump (verified live: <0.0002 jump distance on both an arm and a leg). This is a from-scratch reimplementation of Rigify's own IK-to-FK snap, not a call to Rigify's operator -- that operator did nothing when invoked headlessly/via MCP despite reporting success.
